integrity: A standalone exact-rational verifier cross-checks all facet-pair ranks and outward Gram cosines for q=2,...,7; finite checks corroborate but do not replace the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The general theorem uses the known exhaustive 2-row Monge facet/vertex classification and applies only to the inherited Euclidean metric; analogous formulas for 3 or more rows and anisotropic metrics are not proved. The scale-rescaled angles fail uniform integrability, and historical priority is provisional against unindexed equivalent work.
title: Five-angle ridge spectrum and an anomalous angular mean in two-row Monge polytopes
